recentIncidents.title: Elevated API Error Rates and Latencies

updates.body: 我们发现 CN-NORTH-1 区域的 API 错误率和延迟有所升高。| We are experiencing elevated API error rates and latencies in the CN-NORTH-1 Region.

我们确认 CN-NORTH-1 区域的多项 AWS 服务出现严重错误率问题。在此期间，客户调用 AWS API 时会遇到延迟增加和 5XX 错误。客户在使用 AWS 服务管理控制台时也可能遇到错误，部分 AWS 终端节点也可能出现连接问题。工程师已被自动调动并立即开始调查。对于部分服务（例如 EC2），影响主要集中在 cnn1-az1。对于 EC2，我们建议客户尝试在其他可用区中启动实例。我们正在积极核实对根本原因的判断，同时努力减轻对 AWS 服务的影响。我们将在北京时间11月19日早上 2:00 提供下一次更新；如有更多信息，我们会提前发布。| We can confirm significant error rates for multiple AWS Services in the CN-NORTH-1 Region. During this time, customers will experience increased latencies and 5XX errors when calling AWS APIs. Customers may also experiencing errors when interacting with AWS Service Management Consoles, and connectivity issues to some AWS endpoints. Engineers were automatically engaged and immediately began investigating. For some services, such as EC2, impact is primarily limited to cnn1-az1. For EC2, we recommend customers attempt to launch in other Availability Zones. We are actively working on both verifying our understanding of the root cause, and mitigating impact to AWS Services. We will provide another update at 10:00 AM, or sooner if we have additional information to share.

我们已查明导致 CN-NORTH-1 区域多项 AWS 服务出现严重错误率问题的根本原因。我们已观察到初步的恢复迹象，并将继续监控，努力实现全面恢复。工程师已被自动调动，正在继续努力全面缓解所有问题。现有资源（例如 EC2 实例和 RDS 数据库实例）未受此问题影响。此次影响是由一个负载均衡器的问题引起的，该负载均衡器负责将流量路由到 SQS 和 SNS，并为 AWS 内部服务提供 DNS 支持。此问题也影响到了其他 AWS 服务，受影响的服务列表见下文。我们建议客户尽可能重试失败的 API 请求。我们将在北京时间11月19日早上 2:15 提供下一次更新；如有更多信息，我们会提前发布。| We have identified the root cause resulting in significant error rates for multiple AWS Services in the CN-NORTH-1 Region. We are seeing early signs of recovery and continue to monitor and work toward full recovery. Engineers were automatically engaged, and continue to work on fully mitigating all issues. Existing resources, such as EC2 Instances and RDS DB Instances are unaffected by this issue. This impact is the result of an issue with a load balancer that is responsible for routing traffic to SQS, SNS, and for DNS supporting internal AWS services. This impact is also affecting other AWS Services. A list of impacted services is available below. We recommend customers retry failed API requests wherever possible. We will provide another update at 10:15 AM, or sooner if we have additional information to share.

北京时间 2026 年 11 月 19 日 00:15 至 01:36 期间，CN-NORTH-1 区域的多项 AWS 服务出现了严重的错误率问题和 DNS 解析超时。工程师已立即被自动调动，开始查明根本原因并减轻影响。在此期间，客户向 AWS 服务终端节点发出 API 请求时，延迟和错误率均有所增加。现有资源（例如 EC2 实例）未受此问题影响。北京时间 01:03，我们查明根本原因是一个负载均衡器出现问题，该负载均衡器负责将流量路由到 SQS 和 SNS，并为 AWS 内部服务提供 DNS 支持。北京时间 01:15，我们开始观察到初步的恢复迹象，并持续进行缓解工作。北京时间 01:36，影响已完全消除。我们建议客户重试失败的请求。我们预计此问题不会再次发生。该问题已解决，AWS 服务现已恢复正常运行。| Between 8:15 AM and 9:36 AM PST, we experienced significant error rates and DNS resolution timeouts for multiple AWS Services in the CN-NORTH-1 Region. Engineers were immediately and automatically engaged, and began working on both identifying the root cause and mitigating impact. During this time customers experienced increased latencies and error rates for API requests to AWS Service endpoints. Existing resources, such as EC2 instances were unaffected by this issue. At 9:03 AM, we identified the root cause as an issue with a load balancer responsible for routing traffic to SQS, SNS, and DNS that supports internal AWS services. By 9:15 AM, we began observing early signs of recovery, and continued mitigation efforts until impact was fully resolved at 9:36 AM. We recommend customers retry failed requests. We do not expect this issue to reoccur. The issue has been resolved and AWS Services are operating normally.
